name: @ryntra/client
description: The typed, read-only client for the Ryntra API v1: every public read the contract serves, with the answers checked against it, five error classes to branch on, cursor pagination and idempotency keys. Generated from openapi/ryntra-api-v1.yaml, which is generated from the contract the routes validate with. No dependency beyond fetch; no key, no signature, no write.

ryntra.contractVersion: exported as CONTRACT_VERSION from src/generated/contract.ts — kept in one place so no copy of it can go stale
